description: Every hypothesis that died, with the stage and reason. Rejections at plausibility and feasibility, hypotheses beaten on novelty, and pre-registered hypotheses whose confirmatory or replication result was null. Null results are commits, not deletions. A pipeline whose git history contains only wins is a pipeline that has been p-hacked.

entries.statement: The association between STK11 loss-of-function and shorter overall survival on immune checkpoint inhibition is smaller in patients of East Asian genetic ancestry than in patients of European genetic ancestry with advanced lung adenocarcinoma, i.e. genetic ancestry modifies the STK11 effect.
entries.reason: The exposure is a proxy for variables already in the model. Every link in the chain after 'East Asian ancestry' is a smoking or co-mutation variable — higher never-smoker fraction, lower tobacco signature, fewer KRAS alleles — and smoking status, pack-years, KRAS and KEAP1 status are all entered as covariates in the same model. Adjusted, the ancestry term tests nothing new; unadjusted, this is a smoking analysis wearing an ancestry label. No step runs from germline ancestry to LKB1 signalling, STING regulation or antigen processing. The one route that could have made it mechanistic — germline HLA class I supertype diversity, which does vary by ancestry and would modify precisely the presentation step LKB1 loss degrades (C-031) — is neither proposed nor recoverable from the stated exposure definition. The empirical anchor is not an ancestry contrast: C-023 is a Japanese national-database cohort compared across papers with US cohorts differing in health system, ICI access, line distribution, referral pattern and panel content. Within a single US cohort the East-Asian-versus-European contrast is confounded with institution, insurance, socioeconomic position and time to treatment, none of which the design separates. Finally, the same never-smoker premise is used by H-004 to predict a LARGER STK11 effect and here to predict a SMALLER one, which shows the premise fixes no direction and cannot support either.

entries.statement: Among never-smokers with advanced NSCLC receiving first-line ICI-containing therapy, STK11 loss-of-function is associated with a larger reduction in overall survival relative to STK11 wild-type than it is among ever-smokers, i.e. smoking status modifies the STK11 effect in the direction of a stronger effect in never-smokers.
entries.reason: Underpowered. The identifying cell is a REAL 34 patients across all NSCLC, a fourfold upward correction on the prior run's estimated 8-10, and the verdict does not move — because 34 is an untreated-restricted count and the hypothesis is about first-line ICI-containing therapy. Only 46.9% of STK11-LoF NSCLC patients received any anti-PD-1/PD-L1 agent (336/716, real) and roughly two thirds of those in first line, leaving ~10 analysable patients in the never-smoker/EGFR-ALK-wildtype/STK11-LoF cell, ~16 if the line restriction is dropped. That cell contributes 89% of the interaction variance on its own. The minimum detectable smoking-by-STK11 ratio-of-hazard-ratios is 3.37 at an assumed 60% event fraction and 2.86 even at 80%; the absolute ceiling, obtained by discarding the treatment restriction entirely and thereby testing a different hypothesis, is 1.93. No published result and no reading of the mechanism predicts an interaction of that size. Compounding it, the modifier defining the strata is nlp_extracted smoking status with misclassification concentrated at the never/ever boundary itself, and the EGFR/ALK exclusion that collapses the cell cannot be relaxed without destroying the contrast. Rejected here rather than carried to pre-registration, where a null would be uninterpretable and a positive result would be noise from single-digit event counts. Recorded in the graveyard with the real cell count, so that the next person who proposes this knows the number is 34 and not a guess.

entries.statement: In patients aged 75 or older with advanced NSCLC receiving first-line ICI-containing therapy, STK11 loss-of-function is associated with a larger reduction in overall survival relative to STK11 wild-type than in patients under 65.
entries.reason: The load-bearing step is a single mouse claim that failed replication in another mouse model within the same graph: C-027 (LKB1 loss drives T-cell-suppressive neutrophil accumulation) is contradicted by C-009, in which the same enrichment was explicitly not observed. Building an age-modification hypothesis on the contested limb of a contested preclinical mechanism is exactly the kind of reach stage 3 exists to stop. Worse, the chain does not fix the claimed direction. 'Myeloid suppression costs most where priming reserve is lowest' is one reading; the equally available saturation reading — a host who already primes poorly loses little more when the tumour also fails to prime — predicts a SMALLER STK11 effect in the elderly. A mechanism that supports both signs predicts neither. Nothing in the chain is ICI-specific either: immunosenescence plus an aggressive genotype predicts worse survival on any therapy, and with no non-ICI arm the design cannot tell the two apart. Finally, any age-band difference in a survival hazard is dominated by competing non-cancer mortality, ECOG and comorbidity, and by preferential assignment of monotherapy or attenuated regimens after 75 — all of which act on overall survival regardless of STK11 and none of which the listed covariates resolve. The candidate's own rationale concedes the gap is open 'because nobody has thought it interesting', which is the weaker kind of gap.

entries.statement: The association between STK11 loss-of-function and shorter survival on anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy is weaker when the ICI is given in the second line or later after platinum-based chemotherapy than when it is given in the first line.
entries.reason: Neither limb of the proposed mechanism survives inspection. The platinum-compensation limb requires prior chemotherapy to restore innate priming by generating DNA damage and cytosolic dsDNA — but the LKB1 mechanism in this graph is loss of STING and hence loss of the capacity to SENSE cytosolic dsDNA (C-029/C-030), compounded by a compromised immunoproteasome (C-031). Followed honestly, the mechanism predicts that platinum cannot compensate in exactly the tumours where the sensor is silenced, so it does not support the claimed attenuation. The remaining limb, depletion of susceptibles, is not biology at all: it is survivorship selection, and a hypothesis whose prediction is 'the association is smaller in a group defined by having already survived' restates the selection process rather than proposing a mechanism. The comparison is additionally confounded by construction: first-line ICI monotherapy requires PD-L1 TPS ≥50% whereas second-line monotherapy is given irrespective of PD-L1, so the two strata differ systematically on the strongest known effect modifier in this literature, as well as on calendar era, prior-treatment response and performance status at the index line. Named confounders fully account for the predicted pattern.

entries.statement: In advanced lung adenocarcinoma treated with anti-PD-1/PD-L1 monotherapy, the KRAS-mutant/STK11-mutant (KL) genotype is associated with a lower probability of durable clinical benefit than the KRAS-mutant/TP53-mutant (KP) genotype, and this ordering persists within each PD-L1 expression band.
entries.reason: Rejected on a missing required field, and the basis is narrower than at the prior run because the schema changed — so it was re-derived rather than carried over. PD-L1 is no longer absent: pdl1_sample_nlp and pdl1_history_nlp are real NSCLC fields with real counts. But they are binary NLP-derived positive/negative flags, not tumour proportion scores, and the load-bearing clause of the statement is 'this ordering persists within each PD-L1 expression band'. A binary positive pools 1-49% with >=50%, which is exactly the distinction the hypothesis requires; the three bands cannot be constructed and the within-band estimand cannot be defined. Without the stratification the hypothesis degenerates into an unstratified KL-versus-KP comparison, which is the 2018 Skoulidis analysis it exists to supersede and which stage 2 correctly judged confounded by the PD-L1 distribution by construction. Two workarounds are declined rather than engineered around: CD274 amplification is a ~1%-prevalence copy-number event, not a protein-expression proxy; and inferring TPS >= 50% from receipt of ICI monotherapy replaces a measurement with a prescribing decision. Power is an independent second objection — the real KL count is 385 across all NSCLC, of which ~54 survive the monotherapy and driver restrictions and ~23 have any recorded PD-L1 at all, leaving roughly 8 per band. Assay platform and antibody clone, two of the hypothesis's own listed covariates, are also absent. Paired-prereg consequence: H-008 fails on the same field, so the pair stage 3 asked to be pre-registered and interpreted jointly fails symmetrically and neither half is orphaned.

entries.statement: Among patients with PD-L1 TPS of at least 50% receiving first-line anti-PD-1 monotherapy, STK11 loss-of-function is not associated with shorter overall survival relative to STK11 wild-type, i.e. the apparent STK11 penalty in unstratified ICI cohorts is largely accounted for by the PD-L1-low distribution of STK11-mutant tumours.
entries.reason: The population is defined by a measurement the dataset does not make, and — a change from the prior assessment — power now fails independently as well. On the field: PD-L1 exists in this schema for the first time, as pdl1_sample_nlp and pdl1_history_nlp, but as binary NLP-derived positive/negative flags. H-008 is not a hypothesis about NSCLC with a PD-L1 covariate; it is a hypothesis about the TPS >= 50% stratum specifically and about the gradient across <1%, 1-49% and >=50%. A binary positive pools 1-49% with >=50%, so substituting it would silently redefine the population as PD-L1 >=1%, where the premise (high PD-L1 marks an intact interferon axis and hence a functionally non-deficient STK11 mutant) simply does not hold. Three of the hypothesis's own covariates — assay, clone, specimen-to-treatment interval — are equally absent, and the pdl1 fields are not even declared in the schema's tables section. On power: the prior formula-derived run concluded the cohort was large enough and died only on measurement. The real treatment counts halve that stratum — 2665 ICI-treated NSCLC patients, 336 STK11-LoF, giving ~65 mutant against ~450 wildtype after the first-line, monotherapy and driver restrictions — and the equivalence bound at an assumed 60% event fraction is roughly 0.72-1.40, against Papillon-Cavanagh's published 0.76-1.67. That is not the advance the hypothesis promised, and applying any PD-L1 restriction widens it to 0.65-1.54, which is no advance at all. Using receipt of first-line monotherapy as a proxy for TPS >= 50% is declined: it replaces a measurement with a prescribing decision and cannot produce the low and intermediate bands the gradient prediction requires. Paired-prereg consequence: H-007 fails on the same field, so stage 3's joint-interpretation instruction lapses cleanly rather than leaving a surviving half to reinterpret.

entries.statement: Among STK11-loss-of-function advanced non-squamous NSCLC patients, first-line platinum-doublet plus anti-PD-1 is associated with longer overall survival than first-line anti-PD-1 monotherapy, and the advantage of adding chemotherapy is larger in STK11-mutant than in STK11-wildtype patients.
entries.reason: Rejected on a missing required field, with underpowering as an independent second reason. PD-L1 now exists in this schema as a binary NLP flag, so the rejection was re-derived rather than carried over — and the binary flag makes things worse here rather than better. In H-010 PD-L1 is not a covariate to be dropped; it is the restriction the hypothesis itself introduces to keep confounding by indication from consuming the estimate, and its stated purpose is to exclude TPS <50% 'where monotherapy is rarely used'. A binary 'positive' includes the 1-49% band, which is precisely where monotherapy is rarely used, so substituting it readmits the population the restriction exists to remove and reinstates the confounding it exists to defuse. The obvious alternative — treat receipt of monotherapy as evidence of TPS >= 50% — is circular, because regimen is the exposure being contrasted, and is refused rather than engineered around. Power fails on its own: the real ICI-treated STK11-LoF pool is 336 patients, which after the first-line, non-squamous, driver and regimen splits leaves roughly 65 monotherapy and 121 chemo-immunotherapy STK11-LoF patients, and roughly 36 in the chemo-immunotherapy arm once the required PD-L1 band is applied. The minimum detectable regimen-by-STK11 ratio-of-hazard-ratios is 2.23 at an assumed 60% event fraction, far above anything the mechanism predicts and pointing the opposite way to Skoulidis 2024, which argues chemo-immunotherapy is itself compromised in these tumours. Two further listed covariates, treating site and any comorbidity measure beyond nlp-extracted ECOG, are also absent — and site is exactly the variable the exposure-dependent-prescribing threat requires.

entries.statement: In advanced NSCLC treated with anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy, the survival advantage normally associated with high tumour mutational burden is attenuated or absent in STK11-loss-of-function tumours relative to STK11-wildtype tumours, i.e. STK11 status modifies the TMB-benefit relationship.
entries.reason: Underpowered for the interaction the hypothesis actually predicts. This verdict CHANGED from the prior stage-4 run, and the change is entirely attributable to the schema going from formula-derived to real. The prior run derived ~3060 analysable ICI-treated NSCLC patients with ~430 STK11-mutants from a cohort-wide ICI count and an assumed NSCLC share; the real figures are 2665 ICI-treated NSCLC patients with 336 STK11-LoF among them, so the exposed cell is 22% smaller and the exposure prevalence is 12.6% rather than 14.1%. On the same continuous specification the minimum detectable per-SD ratio-of-hazard-ratios is 1.26 at an assumed 60% event fraction unrestricted, 1.38 if TMB comparability forces restriction to IMPACT468 (a real 50.2% of the cohort), and 1.60 if TMB is dichotomised. Set against that: the estimand is the ratio of the per-SD TMB hazard ratio in STK11-mutants to that in wildtype patients, and within-ICI-arm TMB slopes in NSCLC correspond to a per-SD hazard ratio of roughly 0.80-0.85, so COMPLETE abolition of the slope in STK11-mutants — the strongest form of the claim — is a ratio of only 1.18-1.25. The design cannot detect it. The prior run passed this on the assertion that the mechanism implies an effect 'well beyond 1.25-fold'; that assertion was never converted into a number, and when it is, it is false for any plausible wildtype slope. This is the interaction-needs-four-times-the-events rule biting where the brief said it hides: 2265 patients is a comfortable main-effect cohort and an inadequate interaction cohort at 12.6% exposure prevalence. The clinical claim the hypothesis exists to support — that TMB-high should not justify ICI monotherapy in an STK11-mutant tumour — is too consequential to rest on an interval that cannot exclude the null under the hypothesis's own best case. Sent to the graveyard rather than to pre-registration, with the note that it becomes viable in a cohort with roughly four times these ICI-treated numbers, or in a pooled multi-institution analysis.

entries.statement: In a first-line advanced NSCLC population analysed with a time-to-event rather than a binary endpoint, STK11 loss-of-function is associated with a modestly shorter time to progression or death on anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy, an association the PIONeeR primary-resistance analysis was structurally unable to detect.
entries.reason: There is no causal story here, only a measurement argument. Every reason given for expecting the association — dichotomisation of a time-to-event outcome, a second-line population, multiplicity adjustment across an unrelated biomarker panel — concerns how PIONeeR was analysed, not what LKB1 does. The statement itself, 'STK11 loss-of-function is associated with a modestly shorter time to progression or death on anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy', restates the correlation the field has already pooled across 14 studies and 4,317 patients (C-039, PFS HR 1.45). No step is proposed that could be false about biology, and no differential prediction is made: the candidate's own expectation is 'a small, real, and prognostic-looking effect', which by construction cannot distinguish prediction from prognosis in a design with no non-ICI comparator. H-001 asks the same underlying question with the comparator arm that makes it answerable; H-012 is that design with the discriminating contrast deleted, so it tests nothing H-001 does not test better. A methodological improvement on a prior null is a good reason to re-analyse someone else's data; it is not a hypothesis.

entries.statement: In resectable NSCLC treated with neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy, KRAS/STK11 co-mutation is associated with shorter recurrence-free survival after resection without a correspondingly lower major pathologic response rate, i.e. pathologic response and durable disease control dissociate in this genotype.
entries.reason: The dissociation requires that major pathologic response after neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy is driven by the cytotoxic component and is therefore LKB1-independent. That premise is false: pathologic response in this setting is overwhelmingly attributable to the checkpoint inhibitor added to chemotherapy — pathologic complete response rises roughly tenfold when anti-PD-1 is added to neoadjuvant platinum doublet, against a low single-digit rate for chemotherapy alone. So the very antigen-presentation and priming defects the hypothesis invokes to explain the recurrence-free survival deficit (C-031, C-029, C-036) predict a LOWER major pathologic response rate as well. Followed honestly, the mechanism predicts concordance between the two endpoints, not the claimed dissociation. The other limb is worse: 'no correspondingly lower MPR' rests on 17% versus 25% with p=1.0 in 21 patients, of whom 7 were co-mutant (C-045). Sampling noise is a complete explanation for that null and no biology is needed. The RFS limb (C-044, HR 7.09) comes from a review restating a primary report the mapper never opened, in a cohort of the same 7 co-mutants. Building a surrogate-endpoint claim on a seven-patient cell whose non-significant arm is treated as a finding inverts the evidence.

entries.statement: Biallelic STK11 inactivation is associated with shorter overall survival on ICI-containing therapy than monoallelic or missense-only STK11 alteration, and monoallelic missense STK11 alteration behaves like STK11 wild-type.
entries.reason: The exposure cannot be measured, and nothing in the schema refresh changes that — the new counts are patient-level aggregates and add no locus-level genomic annotation, so this rejection is re-affirmed on re-derivation rather than carried over. Zygosity is genuinely missing rather than nearly present: genomic_variant.alteration_type supplies a bare categorical 'deletion' with no copy-number value, log2 ratio, allele-specific copy number or B-allele frequency, so a deletion call cannot be assumed homozygous; there is no LOH call anywhere; fraction_genome_altered is genome-wide, not locus-level; and there is no clonality or cancer-cell-fraction field. The proposed derivation from VAF and purity is not sound, and the reason is structural rather than a matter of precision: expected VAF = p*m/(p*CN_t + 2(1-p)) contains two unknowns, tumour copy number at the locus and mutant multiplicity, and the schema supplies neither. At 60% purity a heterozygous variant, a variant with LOH and a copy-neutral-LOH variant give VAFs of 0.30, 0.43 and 0.60, and a subclonal variant in a gained region can reproduce any of them. The comparator stratum is worse than the exposed one: 'monoallelic with retained heterozygosity' is a positive assertion that the data can only approximate by the absence of a deletion call, which on a panel that may not interrogate copy number at STK11 is a null result of unknown sensitivity. The resulting misclassification would be directional and outcome-correlated — low-purity samples get called monoallelic, and purity tracks tumour content, biopsy site and disease burden, all prognostic — so the derived contrast would be partly a purity contrast, exactly the artefact the hypothesis itself listed first among its confounding risks, and adjusting for tumor_purity cannot repair it because purity would be both the cause and the adjustment. This is flagged rather than worked around, per the stage rule. Power is secondary and also worse than the prior run believed: the real ICI-treated STK11-LoF pool of 336 gives roughly 90 / 55 / 40 patients across the three zygosity strata after the first-line and driver restrictions, a minimum detectable hazard ratio of ~1.70 between adjacent strata, and an equivalence limb (monoallelic missense resembles wild-type) resting on ~40 patients that could not exclude anything. If this dataset ever carries allele-specific copy number and cancer cell fraction, H-014 is the most mechanistically motivated hypothesis in the set and should be revisited first.

entries.statement: In advanced NSCLC treated with anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy, the excess hazard associated with STK11 loss-of-function is concentrated in the early months after treatment start and diminishes thereafter, i.e. the STK11 effect is front-loaded and the proportional-hazards assumption fails for it.
entries.reason: A hazard ratio that declines with time is the generic signature of unmeasured heterogeneity, not evidence of a priming-failure mechanism. In any population with a frailty distribution, the frail exposed patients leave the risk set first and the marginal hazard ratio drifts toward one even when the individual-level ratio is exactly constant. The proposed mechanism therefore predicts a pattern that its leading alternative predicts equally well, and no discriminator is offered: the design cannot distinguish 'LKB1-deficient tumours fail priming within the first cycles' from 'STK11 marks aggressive disease and the most aggressive die first'. The hypothesis is also the one most damaged by its own acknowledged design flaw — the early interval carries the entire signal, and the early interval is exactly what a sequencing-conditioned cohort under-observes, because patients must survive to be sequenced. Left truncation removes the very events the hypothesis is about, and no amount of adjustment recovers them. Finally, nothing in the chain is ICI-specific: early excess death in an aggressive genotype is expected on chemotherapy too, and with no non-ICI arm the 'needs early response assessment, not denial of checkpoint blockade' implication does not follow from a positive result. The strongest on-point evidence, PIONeeR's binary primary-resistance endpoint, is the design most sensitive to a front-loaded effect and it was null (C-046).
